subtitle: National Innovation Challenge in Nuclear Engineering & Digital Twins
Engineering the Future. Innovating for Impact. Building Tomorrow's Leaders.

sections.heading: About the Hackathon
paragraphs: ATOMIC HACK INDIA 2026 is a premier national innovation challenge designed to bridge the gap between academic theory and industrial practice. Hosted at IIT Bombay, it invites students to solve engineering and technological case studies in nuclear energy, power engineering, digitalization of industrial facilities, digital twins, critical infrastructure and smart grids, using ROSATOM's professional REPEAT VISION modeling platform. Trial licenses are provided upon registration.
REPEAT VISION is a design, mathematical modeling and digital twin creation environment built for design and educational institutes, engineering bureaus and industrial companies.
Join us to innovate, collaborate and shape the future of India's energy sector alongside top experts from ROSATOM and IITB.

sections.heading: Background
paragraphs: India's ambitious energy targets require a new generation of engineers skilled in simulation and digital twins. ATOMIC HACK INDIA connects academia with industry to foster practical innovation.

faqs.a: Atomic Hack is a team competition for programmers and engineers to solve engineering and technological case studies in nuclear engineering, digital twins and critical infrastructure within a short timeframe.
No. Teams of 3–4 people can take part. It's difficult for one person to cover all the competencies needed, but we can help you find a team.

faqs.q: I don't have a team. What should I do?
faqs.a: Join an existing team for the duration of the hackathon, or create your own, on our participant platform. The platform shows all available teams and people looking for a team.

Any student who is 18 or older as of the registration start date. In some cases, participants aged 16–17 may take part with written consent from their legal representatives. We recommend including electrical power engineers in your team.

faqs.q: Do I need prior REPEAT VISION experience?
faqs.a: No. We provide introductory webinars and documentation before the hackathon starts.

faqs.q: What if my laptop isn't powerful enough?
faqs.a: REPEAT VISION runs on standard laptops and also has a cloud version hosted in India. No high-end hardware is required.
Yes. In your final presentation, you must clearly indicate which AI tools you used and for what purposes. You are responsible for independently explaining and defending all technical solutions.

faqs.q: Where will the hackathon take place?
What awaits participants at the venue?
faqs.a: Branded merchandise, prize draws, interaction with experienced mentors, experts and ROSATOM mentors, and an unforgettable atmosphere.
